narrative:
## Group Board Submission — BU Consolidation & Sign-off

The FY2027 BU plan is ready for UK CFO sign-off and Group Board submission.

## Key Decisions
- FY2027 revenue GBP 3.80B, operating margin 9.6%, finance gate passed
- Cost-of-care ratio improved to 73.6%
- Capex GBP 245M inside the GBP 250M envelope

## Recommendations
- Retire Oracle EPM for BU planning at the Q1 renewal
- Extend the same model to the PeopleSoft GL replacement

## Risk Factors
- Medical inflation downside of GBP 40M
- Clinic ramp execution in London

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.

signals.title: PeopleSoft GL Approaching End of Support
signals.excerpt: Any GL replacement must feed the planning model directly, avoiding a new reconciliation layer between ledger and plan.
